story_text: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Create booking with a name at the defined maximum length (0-255)
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a guest name at the maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters).
2. Verify the response status code and message.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · full name stored and returned without truncation

positive.title: Verify long name is stored and retrieved without truncation
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a guest name at the maximum allowed length (e.g., 255 characters).
2. Verify the response status code and message.
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · full name stored and returned without truncation

negative.title: Create booking with a name one character above the maximum
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a guest name exceeding the maximum allowed length.
2. Verify the response status code and message.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states max character length

negative.title: Create booking with an empty string as guest name
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with an empty string as the guest name.
2. Verify the response status code and message.

negative.title: Create booking with guest name as null
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a null value for the guest name.
2. Verify the response status code and message.

edge.title: Create booking with guest name containing Unicode and special characters
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a guest name containing Unicode and special characters.
2. Verify the response status code and message.
edge.expected_result: 201 Created · name stored and returned exactly as submitted (UTF-8 support)

edge.title: Create booking with guest name containing SQL injection payload
steps: 1. Submit a booking request with a guest name containing SQL injection payload.
2. Verify the response status code and message.
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request or safely stored as literal string · no DB error, no data loss
